Hi Alex / Samir —

Thanks — both windows look good on our side. A couple quick questions to make sure we configure the right environment:
1) Would you prefer a single 90-minute combined session or two shorter tracks (45m console + 45m API) so your product folks can split attendance?
2) Can you provide a short list (3–5) of representative prompts or API usage patterns you plan to run in the sandbox? That helps Dev tune the demo payloads.
3) Do you want us to demo using Redwood-hosted model variants or provision a temporary workspace for you to point at your internal model?

I will loop in Dev (cc) to handle the API lab and provisioning. I attached a short prework PDF that lists recommended accounts, ports, and test data we need ahead of time.

Attachments: [attachment: continuum_prework.pdf (PDF, 780 KB)]

Proposed confirmation: Tue Jul 21, 10:00–11:30 PST (90 min) — let me know if you prefer the split-track option. If you confirm, I'll send a calendar invite + runsheet and provision sandbox access.

Best,

Irene / Alex —

I can take the API enablement portion. Quick ask from my side: please share
- 3 example prompts/workflows (input size, expected output length)
- IP allowlist (if any) and whether you need an internal-only service account vs. a public test token

I'll prepare a lightweight Postman collection and a small Node.js sample that demonstrates streaming + prefix caching. If we go with the combined 90-min session, I recommend we reserve ~40 minutes for hands-on lab time where Alex/Samir can run the same calls from their laptops.
